title: Export and import verified offline repository bundles
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Export and import verified offline repository bundles
events.body:
## Outcome

Move a repository and its in-repo collaboration history between disconnected nodes with integrity checks before any destination changes.

## Implementation

- Add one bundle service used by desktop actions and headless commands.
- Export selected refs with a sidecar manifest containing repository identity, included refs, object format, byte size, creation time, and sha256.
- Stream bundle creation and verification off the GUI thread with progress and cancellation.
- On import, verify checksum, prerequisites, repository identity, and refs before creating or updating a mirror.
- Make repeated import of the same bundle idempotent and keep partial output outside the destination.

## Acceptance criteria

- A round trip preserves selected code refs and `.forkmesh` collaboration records.
- Corrupt, truncated, prerequisite-missing, or wrong-repository bundles are rejected without touching the destination.
- Re-importing the same bundle produces no duplicate refs or records.
- Large files do not buffer fully in application memory or block the GUI.
- Desktop and headless paths share verification code.

## Dependencies

Depends on #435 for the Git compatibility harness.

## Verification

Test empty, multi-branch, tagged, collaboration-heavy, incremental, corrupt, wrong-identity, canceled, and large simulated bundle cases.
